name: Azhar Tarek
source_profile: ● Azhar Tarek (LG) is the captain of the Dune Riders. He supports Nahira's authority but opposes permitting armed Cadorian patrols onto Qasari territory. He believes the tribe must be prepared to defend its wells if diplomacy fails.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 68 (source excerpt; may be partial)
